==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Speak with [[Sergeant Bokkun]] about the [[heket]] rumor.
* See [[Commander Tanmod]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 150 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Go to [[Dzagonur Bastion (outpost)|Dzagonur Bastion]]. Walk out to the [[Mirror of Lyss]], and talk to [[Sergeant Bokkun]]. Go back in to Dzagonur Bastion, and collect your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Sergeant Bolrob'''
:''"Ahai, Sunspear. I could use your help. I serve [[Prince Ahmtur the Mighty|Ahmtur the Mighty]], who holds the [[Citadel of Dzagon]] against the inhuman [[heket]]. I've been hearing rumors that the numbers of these toad-like creatures are increasing, and they may be amassing for an attack. Find my colleague, '''Sergeant Bokkun''', in the '''Mirror of Lyss''' and gather what information you can. Then speak to '''Commander Tanmod''' and deliver a report on the situation."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I'll track down Bokkun and get to the bottom of this.
|decline = I'm sure it's just a rumor. Nothing to worry about....
|ask = We need to confirm the '''heket''' rumors. Talk to '''Sergeant Bokkun''' and learn what you can of the attack.}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
'''Sergeant Bokkun'''
:''"Bolrob is right. I see heket on every ridgeline and in the valleys as well. The attack is imminent, but they are waiting for more units and supplies before striking. Send word to Tanmod that if he requires our services, we are more than willing to send a few heket to their graves!"''

===Reward dialogue===
'''Commander Tanmod'''
:''"Ahai, Sunspear! What brings you here? What? Bokkun says an attack is coming from the heket? Interesting. They're nasty creatures, those foul toads, but they don't have the equipment or leadership to assault the Citadel. Still, we can't be too careful. I need more details, and you can help me get them!"''
